definitions.explanation: A business or person that buys goods in bulk from manufacturers and sells them to retailers. An intermediary in the supply chain between producers and retail shops.

examples.japanese: {卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
examples.english: We purchase directly from the wholesaler.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}さ→通す：02300_toosu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This product is sold without going through a wholesaler.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{各店舗|かくてんぽ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}けている→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: The food wholesaler delivers fresh vegetables to each store every morning.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{卸|おろし}→卸：10906_oroshi⟧ (wholesale) + ⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧ (business operator). Refers to the middleman between manufacturers and retailers. In Japan, the wholesale distribution system is an important part of the commercial structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ} (food wholesaler)
- {卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to go through a wholesaler)
- {卸業者|おろしぎょうしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧ (to purchase from a wholesaler)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{問屋|とんや}→問屋：07941_tonya⟧: wholesale dealer — a traditional term, often for a specific trade
- ⟦{小売業者|こうりぎょうしゃ}→小売業者：22458_kourigyousha⟧: retailer — sells directly to consumers (opposite role)
